name: SEFR
description: Machine learning (TinyML) classifier that trains on the microcontroller itself, in one pass over the data. On-device learning for sensor classification: SEFR (arXiv:2006.04620) learns a linear multiclass model from streamed samples, with an optional LDA refining pass. No dynamic memory; runs on 2 KB RAM boards.
keywords: machine learning, tinyml, ai, edge ai, classifier, classification, on-device learning, on-device training, embedded ml, sensor, gesture recognition, activity recognition, linear classifier, sefr
